options.label: model
options.description: Optional. An exact Goose model id for this session (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4, qwen/qwen3-coder). Leave blank to let Goose resolve its own configured model; atrium cannot enumerate per-provider models, so there is no menu — switch models in-session with /model.

options.label: provider
options.description: Optional. Overrides goose's configured provider for this session (e.g. openrouter, anthropic). Leave blank to inherit goose's config.

options.label: effort
options.description: Optional reasoning effort. Leave blank to inherit (Goose applies the configured / provider / model behavior). Supported levels depend on the active model; an unsupported level makes Goose refuse to start the session. Also changeable in-session, or via GOOSE_THINKING_EFFORT.
